subject: general
question: Name the strait that divides Morocco and Spain.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Strait of Gibraltar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The strait of Gibraltar **separates **Morocco and Spain**.
 
• It joins **the Mediterranean Sea **and **the Atlantic Ocean**.
 
• **A strait **is **a waterway **that **connects two larger bodies **of **water**.
 
• It **is also a channel **of water that lies **between two land masses**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Located **between **Alaska and Russia**, the **Bering Strait **is the **only marine gateway **between the **icy Arctic **and the **Pacific Ocean**. At its **narrowest point**, the **strait is only 55 miles wide**.
 
• **Hudson Strait links **the **Atlantic Ocean **and the **Labrador Sea **to **Hudson Bay **in **Canada**. This strait lies **between Baffin Island **and **Nunavik**.
 
• The **English Channel **also called **the British Channel **is an arm of **the Atlantic Ocean **that separates **Southern England **from northern **France **and **links **to the **southern part **of the **North Sea by the Strait of Dove**.
